meta.title: epona | Restaurant
meta.description: Official website of epona — a reservation-only restaurant offering carefully crafted seasonal dishes in a calm, intimate space in Tokushima.

hero.lead: Seasonal ingredients, and time to savor the quiet.

about.heading: About epona
about.paragraph1: epona is a reservation-only restaurant hosting just one party at a time. We serve nothing but a monthly-changing omakase course made with seasonal ingredients and vegetables and herbs from our own garden.
about.paragraph2: We take reservations first, then source ingredients and cook each dish at its best moment for your visit — which is why we operate by reservation only. Our bread, made with pesticide-free wheat, is also baked fresh to match your reservation time, and our sommelier prepares a drink pairing for each course.
